description: This file defines the LogNode interface, a contract for logging components in an Android application. It specifies a method for outputting log data with optional exception information, facilitating customizable logging chains.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node capable of outputting log messages and passing them along a chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output log data with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
